title.narrative: Community-based approach to facilitating the reintegration of women-headed families returning from Al Hol

description.narrative: The Centre for Humanitarian Dialogue (hereunto referred to as HD) proposes a project for improving community assimilation for women who have returned from Al Hol camp. The project will establish the Womens Committee to coordinate community reconciliation and reintegration support efforts. The Committee will include women from locally-rooted civil society organizations and will coordinate with the Deir ez-Zor Civil Society Platform (also referred to as the DeZ Platform). The DeZ Platform helped facilitate the release of the women from the camp, and has extensive information about their locations and situation. Working in close coordination, the DeZ Platform and the Womens Committee will identify livelihood intervention needs and beneficiaries of the first pilot project targeting 400 families.
